entities.name: CHD7 KS variant spectrum
observations: Review evidence reports approximately 70% of CHD7 variants associated with Kallmann syndrome are missense; matched category counts and denominator were not provided.
A reported 36-patient Dutch KS cohort had three CHD7-positive cases, all with CHARGE-like features, so it does not establish proportions in isolated KS.

entities.name: CHD7 CHARGE variant spectrum
observations: Review evidence characterizes CHD7 variants in typical CHARGE syndrome as predominantly truncating/loss-of-function; directly comparable class counts and denominator were not retrieved.
